brief:
An eight-year-old Palestinian boy died Friday from wounds sustained when Israeli forces opened fire in the Qizan Rashwan area south of Khan Younis, Middle East Eye reported. The boy was struck during the shooting incident in the southern Gaza enclave.

No further details about the circumstances of the shooting or the identity of the child were provided in available reports.

title: Israeli gunfire kills eight-year-old boy in Khan Younis
